mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM sla_clock UNION SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM sla_escalation_target) tenants WHERE tenant_id > #{afterTenantId} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT target_id, recipient_user_id, purpose, status, effective_at, qualification_version, qualification_checked_at, qualification_valid_until, qualification_state, qualification_reason_code, lock_version, created_at, updated_at FROM sla_escalation_target WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND purpose='SLA' AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT target_id, recipient_user_id, purpose, status, effective_at, qualification_version, qualification_checked_at, qualification_valid_until, qualification_state, qualification_reason_code, lock_version, created_at, updated_at FROM sla_escalation_target WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND target_id=#{targetId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sla_escalation_target WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND purpose='SLA' AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_qualification_snapshot (tenant_id,target_id,recipient_user_id,purpose,qualification_version, checked_at,valid_until,eligible,reason_code,created_at,created_by_type,created_by_id) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{targetId},#{recipientUserId},'SLA',#{qualificationVersion},#{checkedAt},#{validUntil},#{eligible},#{reasonCode},#{now}, 'SERVICE', NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recipient_user_id=VALUES(recipient_user_id), qualification_version=VALUES(qualification_version), checked_at=VALUES(checked_at),valid_until=VALUES(valid_until), eligible=VALUES(eligible),reason_code=VALUES(reason_code)
mapper.select: SELECT target_id,recipient_user_id,purpose,qualification_version,checked_at,valid_until, eligible,reason_code FROM sla_qualification_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND target_id=#{targetId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sla_escalation_target SET qualification_version=#{qualificationVersion},qualification_checked_at=#{checkedAt},qualification_valid_until=#{validUntil}, qualification_state=#{state},qualification_reason_code=#{reason},lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND purpose='SLA' AND status='ACTIVE' AND lock_version=#{expectedVersion}
